ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd try streaming on my TV, though my 720p set would not benefit from 4K.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My tablet already covers my screen needs, and I have no current need for a voice assistant.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My camera purchases concern photography accessories; I am not currently shopping for home security.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in practical accessories for my existing devices than adding voice control.
ItemID: NA; Title: All-new Fire HD 10 tablet, 10.1", 1080p Full HD, 32 GB, latest model (2021 release), Black, without lockscreen ads; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The larger screen interests me as a Fire 7 upgrade, but I would choose the more compact HD 8 this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire 7 tablet, 7" display, 16 GB, (2019 release), Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a 16 GB Fire 7, so this feels too similar to justify replacing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Flex - Plug-in mini smart speaker with Alexa; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a specific use for a plug-in voice assistant right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: TOZO T10 Bluetooth 5.3 Wireless Earbuds with Wireless Charging Case IPX8 Waterproof Stereo Headphones in Ear Built in Mic Headset Premium Sound with Deep Bass for Sport White (2022 Upgraded); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently looking for earbuds; storage, mounts, and device accessories better match my recent interests.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A newer smart speaker still does not address a current need for my setup.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Fire HD 8 tablet, 8" HD display, 64 GB, (2020 release), designed for portable entertainment, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd choose this as a portable upgrade from my Fire 7, with a slightly larger screen and more built-in storage.
